discordlogin-desc: Log in with Discord, for members of one Discord server, with Discord roles mapped to wiki groups
discordlogin-error-state: The login took too long or was started in another tab. Please try again.
discordlogin-error-discord: Couldn't talk to Discord ($1). Please try again in a moment.
discordlogin-error-notmember: Only members of the Let's RP Discord server can log in. Join the server, then try again.
discordlogin-error-pending: Your Discord server membership isn't complete yet. Accept the server rules in Discord, then try again.
discordlogin-error-config: Discord login isn't set up correctly. Please tell a wiki administrator.
discordlogin-error-noname: Couldn't make a wiki username from your Discord name. Please tell a wiki administrator.
